title: AI answer source: a metric question answered by fallback (object query) carries no structured non-metric-reading marker, so the source block cannot label it
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: ① a declared behaviour with no structured carrier, found by the dev of #33734 on `main` `bd96ec9c` while measuring that card. #33734 asked for the "non-metric reading" label on a fallback answer. The seat ruled the leg out of #33734's PR (claim amendment 6892165313), because nothing in the structured source marks a fallback. Reader: the spec/server lane, which owns `ObjectQuerySourceSchema` and the ask agent's producer. The ui render follows once a marker exists. Filed as `finding` for triage; this seat does not grade or claim it.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open non-metric reading fallback source` and `is:issue is:open ObjectQuerySource fallback` find nothing open.

## What the user sees

A metric question that falls back to an object query (ADR-0149 D3 rule 4) is answered from `query_records` / `aggregate_records`. Its "How this was computed" block looks exactly like a plain record read. The 「非指标口径」 (non-metric reading) words appear only in the producer's text `source.line`, which the structured block does not draw. So the structured block cannot tell the user that the figure is not the governed metric.

## Where (on `main`)

- `packages/spec/src/ai/object-query-source.zod.ts` `ObjectQuerySourceSchema`: no member marks a fallback reading.
- `packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts` `DatasetProvenanceSchema`: `kind: literal('dataset')`, no fallback member. A fallback is not a dataset answer.
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/AnswerSource.tsx`: draws the object-query block. It deliberately does not draw `line`, and it must not label every object-query answer.

## Acceptance

- The structured source a fallback answer carries says that it is a non-metric reading. Which schema carries it, and in what shape, is for the spec seat to decide under ADR-0149 D3. The producer (cloud ask agent) sets it.
- The chat answer block shows the non-metric label only when the marker is present, with a rendered pin. CONTROL: a plain record read shows no label.

Blocked-by: #33734
